profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Seasoned backend software engineer who has solid understanding of distributed systems engineering with extensive practice in data platform and cloud-scale web service backend.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on backend data movement pipeline and customer API for Azure monitoring service which entails graph representation of all components that are running on Azure cloud. 

Major achievements:
•	Implemented graph traversal on azure components topology for outage impact analysis. Made use of in-memory store which resulted in 83% reduction in average API response time.
•	Designed and implemented row/column based access control across multiple heterogeneous data consumption paths. Projected cost savings from this was over 10 million USD by expediting rolling out of new cloud regions and thereby saving depreciation costs.

company.name: UC Irvine Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences

positions.title: SDE intern
positions.description:
Member of Amazon Global Selling Organization
Worked on Java Backend to instrument pricing of customer transaction for auditing.
Experience includes 
- AWS Lambda, DynamoDB and Redshift
- Java frameworks: Spring and Google Guice

positions.title: software engineer
positions.description:
Member of in-house logging platform team, acted as a backend data pipeline engineer.

Major engineering achivements include
•	Decreased notification delay by 97% by designing a distributed real-time notification service with Apache Storm and Elasticsearch.
•	Implemented Log4j/Log4j2/Logback augmentation as client side SDK for the platform and improved its performance by 500%, by introducing bulk sending feature.
•	Managed 100+ nodes of Elasticsearch and 30+ nodes of Apache Storm Cluster.

Also participated in 
•	Mobile application prototype for the platform with React-Native.
•	Node.js based API server development.
•	Code contribution to Elasticsearch and Apache Storm.
•	Session held at Deview 2015 (Seoul, Korea. Sep 2015): Implementation of a real-time notification system for the logging platform with Apache Storm and Elasticsearch.
•	Session held at ElasticOn Tokyo 2015 (Tokyo, Japan. Dec 2015): Searching and alerting for application logs with elasticsearch at Naver.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Business Administration, Minored in Applied Statistics
